full_judgment: 3. The plaint case in short, was that an area measuring 49 decimals of land appertaining to mouza Gaoail, C.S. Khatian No. 23, plot No. 1054 corresponding to R.S. plot No.1054 and 2033 originally belonged to Alokeshi Bewa and her name was correctly recorded in the C.S. Khatian. Alokeshi Bewa died leaving behind her brother-in-law's son Surendra Mohan Sarkar. While Surendra Mohan Sarkar was in possession of the said land as the rightful owner he sold 27 decimals of land from plot No.1054 to Sheikh Jobed Ali and Sree Roy Chand Sutradhar vide kabala dated 12.05.1951 being No. 2440. Subsequently, Surendra Mohan Sarkar purchased 7812 decimals of land including 27 decimals of land of plot No.1054 from Sheikh Jobed Ali and Sree Roy Chandra Sutradhar through deed dated 01.11.1957 being No.7794, but the record was wrongly prepared in the name of Sree Roy Chand Sutradhar in S.A. Khatian Nos.77, 78 and 391. Surendra Mohan Sarkar died leaving behind two sons Haridash Sarkar and Ruhidas Sarkar and while they were in possession of the suit land they sold 20 decimals of land to plaintiff No.1 vide kabala dated 12.06.1997 being No. 4449. Haridash also sold 1312 decimals of land to plaintiff  No.1 vide kabala dated 19.07.1998 being No. 6467. Defendant Nos.1 and 2 have created a collusive deed on 04.12.1998 in respect of 13 decimals of land showing defendant No.1 as the reversioner heir of S.A. recorded tenant Sree Roy Chand Sutradhar which is false and concocted. The deed dated 04.12.1979 was not binding upon the plaintiffs.
